name: Transoxiana
intro: Between the Oxus and the Jaxartes, the land of Samarkand and Bukhara and home of the Sogdian merchants; ruled in turn by Persians, Greeks, Turks, Arabs, Mongols and Timur.
intro_zh: 阿姆河与锡尔河之间，撒马尔罕、布哈拉所在，粟特商人的故乡，波斯、希腊、突厥、阿拉伯、蒙古、帖木儿先后统治。
